name: Instant Indexing & Check
author: arthurseofr

sections.description:
Instant Indexing & Check (formerly Instant Indexing) helps you get your content indexed faster on Google.

It offers two modes:
1. Google API (Free): Uses your own Google Indexing API JSON key to send indexing requests directly to Google.
2. Premium Force Index: A high-performance indexing service with a 90% success rate for stubborn URLs.

Privacy & Terms

This plugin relies on the following external services to function:

  1. Google Indexing API & Search Console API

    • Used for: Sending indexing requests to Google and checking URL status.
    • Data Sent: The URLs of your content and your Google Cloud Service Account credentials (stored locally).
    • Privacy Policy: Google Privacy Policy

  2. Instant Indexing Premium Relay (wp-instant-indexing.com)

    • Used for: Processing “Premium” indexing requests and validating licenses.
    • Data Sent: Your site URL, license key, and the specific URLs you request to index.
    • Privacy Policy: WP Instant Indexing Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/instant-indexing-check directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the “Instant Index” menu to configure your settings.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Google Cloud account?

Yes, for the Free mode, you need to create a Service Account in Google Cloud and download the JSON key.

Is the Premium mode free?

No, the Premium mode uses a credit system. You can purchase credits directly from the plugin interface.
